							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Our Meeting Minutes and Agendas</h1>

<p>Council advises that Ordinary General Meetings are generally held every third Thursday of each month, with some exceptions due to holidays or key events.</p>
<p>General Meetings are held in the Council Chambers of each respective town as listed in the below schedule, commencing at 9.00am. Meetings are open to the public unless Council resolves to close a meeting to discuss certain matters.</p>
<p><strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/about-council/documents/meeting-minutes-and-agendas/2026/council_meeting_dates-2026-v31.pdf" target="_self" title="council_meeting_dates-2026-V3.pdf" class="styled-button document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>General Meeting Schedule for 2026<span class="file-info">(PDF, 109KB)</span></a></strong></p>
<p>A copy of the full agenda is typically available from the Monday prior to the meeting. Alternatively, contact our Governance team on (07) 4658 4113 for further information. The rules governing meetings are prescribed under the <em>Local Government Act 2009</em>, the <em>Local Government Regulation 2012</em>, and Council's Standing Orders.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.longreach.qld.gov.au/About-Council/Council/Our-Meeting-Minutes-and-Agendas/Standing-Committees" class="styled-button"><strong>Information about Council's standing committees</strong></a></p>
